comparison.scope: Float64 storage and same-algorithm numerical roundoff only; identities, integer counts, units, masks, and bootstrap indices exact

selection.selection_basis: Predeclared scientific identities; no effect size, interval or significance filtering

meaning.departure_contrast: Temporary departure minus final departure within SID
meaning.rise_contrast: Legitimate trough-to-return rise versus same-SID Resolution with unchanged exact roles and wind-bin pairs
meaning.land_contact: Any recorded contact in the preceding 24 hours; no future land-free condition
meaning.rate_integrals: Only saved diagnosed rates are integrated in seconds; KE and APE states are not energy supply integrals
meaning.support: Regional valid-area QC and actual request intersection; no new grid-cell support calculation
